name: ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Sri Damansara
short_description: A 144-room design-economy hotel beside Sri Damansara Barat MRT station, with Family Suites and a fitness centre in KL's northern corridor.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Sri Damansara is a 144-room design-economy property positioned directly beside the Sri Damansara Barat MRT station in Kuala Lumpur's northern corridor, near Kepong and Desa ParkCity. Rooms run from 22 sq m Standard rooms with a queen or twin beds up to 38 sq m Family Suites with a separate sofa living area, and the hotel includes a restaurant, bar, fitness centre and covered parking. Guests consistently call out the MRT-adjacent location and helpful, well-trained front-desk staff as strengths, while a subset of reviews flag inconsistent housekeeping and a fitness centre they found basic for the price. Review scores land in the mid-to-upper range for the ibis Styles economy tier, with the hotel used both by business travelers along the northern corridor and leisure guests connecting into central KL by rail.

Family Suites at 38 sq m with a separate living/sofa area, more space than typical ibis Styles rooms
Guests repeatedly praise helpful, well-trained front-desk staff
Complimentary WiFi and covered parking included
Decathlon Sri Damansara is a 2-minute walk for shopping and essentials
cons: A subset of reviews flag inconsistent housekeeping and cleanliness

research_highlights: The MRT-adjacent location is the single most repeated praise point across guest reviews
Front-desk staff helpfulness comes up consistently and positively in reviews
Kayak aggregates an 8.1/10 'very good' score across roughly 1,014 verified reviews
research_watchouts: TripAdvisor's own star rating (3 of 5) reads more mixed than the Kayak aggregate score, so expectations vary by platform
Some guests specifically call out cleanliness and gym equipment as below expectations

faqs.question: How far is ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Sri Damansara from central Kuala Lumpur?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in the Sri Damansara Barat area, directly beside the Sri Damansara Barat MRT station, giving guests a direct rail link into central Kuala Lumpur. Batu Caves is about 11 km away, roughly a 12-minute drive, while Decathlon Sri Damansara is a 2-minute walk, making the hotel a practical, well-connected base.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Sri Damansara have family rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 144 standard rooms with either a queen bed or twin beds, the hotel offers Family Suites at 38 square metres featuring a queen bed plus a separate living room area with a sofa, giving families more space than the brand's typical compact economy layout found elsewhere in the ibis Styles range.
